items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] With Baby Dodds...Jimmie Noone? [INTERVIEWER] Yeah. Baby Dodds was on some of them, too, right?

ctx.x: time I was there I did Sunday gigs with Harry Lim, did some dances at the Sherman. That's when I played with...that picture you see in the magazines.
Yeah. Baby Dodds was on some of them, too, right?
